title: TTS preview playback UX cleanup
description: Keep the integrated TTS preview player available while removing development-only test controls from the production settings flow.
businessContext: Editors need one clear path to generate and play a voice preview without confusing diagnostic controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings retains one integrated TTS preview action and its audio player.
Diagnostics no longer presents development TTS, CapCut, 9Router, or stock test controls.
Renderer typecheck and focused UI test pass.
humanEscalationConditions: Removing diagnostics would remove a required production workflow action.
